subject: Atomic removal request: excise one conversation from telemetry (RD-47)
messages:
From: Tom Greene <t.greene@medbridgehealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: compliance@medbridgehealth.com
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: remove single conversation from telemetry (RD-47)

Hi Sofia,

We opened a support case earlier this week but want to tighten the scope: there is a single conversation thread between one of our clinicians and an internal pilot account that contains sensitive PII. We specifically need Redwood to remove traces of that one thread from telemetry and any internal logs tied to activity IDs, not a wholesale account purge.

I attached a small archive (SC-logs.zip) with the traces we can identify and the conversation headers. Can you confirm whether Redwood can perform a narrow expunction and provide an audit token once complete? Our compliance team will need the authorization ticket and timestamp for our records.

Thanks,
Tom Greene
Head of Security
MedBridge Health

Attachment: SC-logs.zip (zip) - redacted excerpts

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Greene <t.greene@medbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: remove single conversation from telemetry (RD-47)

Tom —

Thanks for the details and the attachment; that helps a lot. I opened a support case (RD-47) and provisionally marked the scope as "single-thread, telemetry/log-level expunction".

Next steps on our side:
- Marcus (platform ops) will triage the artifacts and confirm the exact activity IDs we can locate.
- Laura (compliance) will confirm the internal approval bundle required to execute the narrow removal.
- I will coordinate timing with you once we have the approval stamp so this can be done during a low-traffic window.

Can you confirm that the only external recipients in that thread are the clinician and the pilot account (no shared Drive links or downstream exports)? If there are storage snapshots elsewhere, call that out now so we can include it in the scope.

—Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: remove single conversation from telemetry (RD-47)

Laura / Sofia —

I pulled the artifacts Tom sent and scanned the telemetry indexes. I can see three activity IDs that map to the conversation snapshots: act-20270718-998, act-20270718-999, act-20270718-1001. Those are the only entries in hot storage; however we do have archived buckets that captured aggregated traces for a 24-hour ingest window.

Proposed execution plan (narrow scope):
1) Perform targeted deletion of the three activity IDs from all runtime telemetry indexes and caches.
2) Mark any associated cache keys as invalid and prime the fallback so client latency is unaffected.
3) Schedule a single archive sweep to remove the aggregated entries from the 24-hour bucket (low risk window).
4) Generate a forensic audit token and write the operation record to our secure audit vault (immutable).

I will not proceed until Laura confirms authorization and we get the signed exemption from MedBridge. ETA for execution after approvals: 24–36 hours.

Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: execution-checklist.txt (text)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
